method.journal: strict storage.replay; count latest revision per event_id
method.name_counts: nested resource.name occurrences, including repeated facts/cause/metadata; not unique names or translation success rate
method.grouped_preview: offline reconstruction at exported game tick; latest accepted order; main tier; max 500 candidates; HistoryIndex.grouped; not a captured UI screen
method.validation_limit: JSON consistency and sender/source checks; no screen recording or full gameplay ground truth
